 Formula One 2026 Mexican Grand Prix qualifying: Lewis Hamilton takes pole – live
 🏎️ F1 updates from 9pm GMT in Mexico City
 🏎️ Giles Richards’ race scene-setter | And mail Philip 
 LIVE  Updated  28s ago Philip Cornwall Sat 31 Oct 2026 18.38 EDT First published on Sat 31 Oct 2026 16.00 EDT Share Key events 12m ago The top 10 
 26m ago Lewis Hamilton takes pole! 
 48m ago Q2 eliminations – with Piastri out 
 1h ago Q1 eliminations 
 3h ago Preamble 
 Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton celebrates after qualifying in pole position. Photograph: Eloisa Sanchez/Reuters View image in fullscreen Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton celebrates after qualifying in pole position. Photograph: Eloisa Sanchez/Reuters Philip Cornwall Sat 31 Oct 2026 18.38 EDT First published on Sat 31 Oct 2026 16.00 EDT Share Key events 12m ago The top 10 
 26m ago Lewis Hamilton takes pole! 
 48m ago Q2 eliminations – with Piastri out 
 1h ago Q1 eliminations 
 3h ago Preamble 
 now 18.38 EDT He wondered if this was his first pole in Mexico. When you have a record 105, it is easy to forget one: he won from pole in 2016.
 Share 3m ago 18.35 EDT There is life in Lewis Hamilton yet. When you heard him talking about racing into the 2030s, to race at an African Grand Prix in Rwanda, it felt inspiring but perhaps overoptimistic. But there he is.
 Share 12m ago 18.26 EDT The top 10
 1 Lewis Hamilton 🇬🇧 Ferrari 1:16.514
 2 George Russell 🇬🇧 Mercedes +0.009
 3 Charles Leclerc 🇲🇨 Ferrari +0.119
 4 Max Verstappen 🇳🇱 Red Bull +0.178
 5 Kimi Antonelli 🇮🇹 Mercedes +0.193
 6 Lando Norris 🇬🇧 McLaren +0.310
 7 Isack Hadjar 🇫🇷 Red Bull +0.386
 8 Liam Lawson 🇳🇿 Racing Bulls +0.515
 9 Arvid Lindblad 🇬🇧 Racing Bulls +0.603
 10 Pierre Gasly 🇫🇷 Alpine +0.639
 Share 15m ago 18.23 EDT And now Hamilton. “Wow. That feels great … So happy. Oh man, I’m lost for words. It’s been a really, really tough, challenging weekend … The engine issue we had yesterday … But it’s so close between us all … Wow. To have a pole here.” He is told he is the oldest driver to have a pole since Mario Andretti in 1982. “Where there’s a will, there’s a way. It’s all in the mind, honestly, for all of us … I love what I do … I dream about it. I have this amazing support around the world, these guys keeps me going, I hope they are happy today, and I hope I can deliver for them tomorrow.”
 Share 20m ago 18.17 EDT Now Russell , who is asked if he is happy. “I am, I am. It’s been a tricky few races for me and still struggling to get on top of this car, to be honest because it’s been a very difficult weekend until one lap in Q3. To almost get pole … it was very close in the end. I always know it’s in there.” His self-belief remains, despite all the frustrations.
 Share 23m ago 18.14 EDT “I was fighting with the car particularly in Q3 … There is such low downforce here.”
 Share 24m ago 18.14 EDT Leclerc speaks. “I just didn’t do a good job. The outlaps were difficult to put the tyres in the right window … A bit disappointed but to start third here is not too bad.”
 Share 25m ago 18.13 EDT So there was no false Ferrari qualifying dawn. And Russell took second – David Croft points out that the two drivers who need to win to keep the title race alive are one and two.
 Share 26m ago 18.11 EDT Lewis Hamilton takes pole!
 Hamilton does it. After Verstappen locks up on 13th then backs off, the Briton gets his first Ferrari pole, his 105th overall.
 View image in fullscreen Hamilton during qualifying. Photograph: Bradley Collyer/PA Share Updated at  18.13 EDT 29m ago 18.09 EDT Final seconds. Here comes Antonelli. Only fifth fastest.
 Share 30m ago 18.08 EDT George Russell +0.009 in second. Leclerc third +0.119.
 Share 30m ago 18.07 EDT Hamilton goes fastest! 1:16.514.
 Share 31m ago 18.07 EDT All going wrong for Hadjar. He misjudged the line coming into the pits. Bernie Collins says the Frenchman is all over the place mentally, complaining more than Gordon Ramsay in a Wimpy.
 Share 34m ago 18.03 EDT Bernie Collins eavesdropping on the drivers, saying their messages are full of uncertainty as to the best strategy.
 Share 35m ago 18.03 EDT Though Verstappen has that one-place penalty.
 Share 37m ago 18.01 EDT Turn 13 unlucky again for Hadjar but Verstappen gets second, +0.045.
 Share 38m ago 18.00 EDT Russell P3 , Antonelli P4, then Norris beat Hamilton at +0.177.
 Share 39m ago 17.59 EDT Leclerc puts in a 1:16.647 for provisional pole. Hamilon +0.422, a middle sector mistake.
 Share 40m ago 17.58 EDT Q3 is go. 
 Share 44m ago 17.54 EDT Karun Chandhok analyses Piastri’s lap. Kerb after kerb after kerb.
 Share 47m ago 17.51 EDT Yet Norris went fastest. Top 10: Nor, Ver, Lec, Ham, Rus, Had, Ant, Lin, Law and Gas.
 Share 48m ago 17.49 EDT Q2 eliminations – with Piastri out
 Blimey. Out go Hulkenberg, Colapinto, Piastri, Bortoleto, Bearman and Sainz. McLaren saved a set of soft tyres but an aborted fast lap doomed Piastri.
 Share 50m ago 17.48 EDT Piastri out! He is 13th fastest!
 Share 51m ago 17.47 EDT Relief for Hamilton. Up in third, at a minuscule +0.077.
 Share 53m ago 17.45 EDT Norris shot up to third. Piastri is 10th. Hulkenberg at seventh is the big disruptor, a threat to Lawson, Hadjar and Piastri. And HAMILTON.
 Share 54m ago 17.43 EDT Drop zone is looking like Gasly, Bortoleto, Bearman, Colapinto, Sainz and HAMILTON.
 Share 1h ago 17.41 EDT Verstappen goes fastest , 1:16.876. Hulkenberg is sixth at present.
 View image in fullscreen Verstappen during qualifying. Photograph: ANP/Shutterstock Share Updated at  17.42 EDT 1h ago 17.41 EDT Hamilton into the pits . Down in the drop zone at present, as is Norris, who was on used tyres initially.
 Share 1h ago 17.39 EDT Lindblad is second at +0.191, ahead of Antonelli at +0.259 and Russell at +0.307.
 Share 1h ago 17.38 EDT Charles Leclerc gets a 1:16.944, while Hamilton goes off the track at turn 13 when on a flyer, which is causing a lot of problems.
 Share 1h ago 17.34 EDT Q2 is go. 
 Share 1h ago 17.32 EDT Hadjar used another set of soft tyres, which explains his margin over Verstappen.
 Share 1h ago 17.31 EDT Something weird happened to Leclerc, a power surge. The spirits of the night?
 Share 1h ago 17.29 EDT Top 10: Ham, Had, Lec, Pia, Rus, Bor, Nor, Hul, Ant, Ver.
 Share 1h ago 17.28 EDT Q1 eliminations
 Out go Albon , Alonso, Hirakawa, Stroll, Perez and Bottas. Hirakawa was about a second slower than Bearman but got a lot of sympathy on the team radio.
 Share 1h ago 17.26 EDT Hadjar has split the Ferraris! +0.044.
 Share 1h ago 17.25 EDT Ollie Bearman 10th fastest for Haas, his new teammate 19th.
 Share 1h ago 17.25 EDT Yellow cleared. Phew. 
 Share 1h ago 17.24 EDT Yellow flags … Could settle things.
